races.display_title: Navan Racing Festival Hospitality On Sale Now Nursery Handicap
races.verdict: PRINCE OF PEPPARD improved at Fairyhouse 16 days ago and, with that form franked, looks capable of going one better from a 3 lb higher mark. Docks took a big step forward when second in a Naas nursery and rates the main danger despite a 5 lb rise, while Santo Parvenue won at Naas last month and continues in form despite his subsequent defeat at Down Royal. PRINCE OF PEPPARD (IRE) DOCKS (IRE) SANTO PARVENUE (IRE)

races.display_title: Navan Racecourse Welcomes Our Local Community Maiden
races.verdict: Probably an above-average maiden for the time of year and JESUS GREEN can get off the mark after a couple of fine efforts in defeat in a maiden and Group 1 at Leopardstown. Selosse shaped well in a red-hot Curragh maiden on debut and will improve, while Choctaw Nation is an appealing newcomer. JESUS GREEN (IRE) SELOSSE (IRE) CHOCTAW NATION (IRE)

races.display_title: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Fillies Handicap
races.verdict: PINK OXALIS has been consistent without winning this year, but is now on a good mark and should go close if reproducing last month’s effort in a stronger handicap. Thrifty of Digby has eased slightly in the weights and tends to bounce back quickly from lesser efforts, so rates the main danger. races.verdict: REPONSE FINALE has been a model of consistency since joining her current yard and, for all she can be slowly away, this track and trip should suit, so she gets the nod. races.display_title: Racing Again 21st October Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
races.verdict: PURE GRANITE is lightly raced for his age and made more impact when fourth at Punchestown on his return from 10 months off. Entitled to strip fitter, he can build on that and open his account. Pebble Island rates the main danger if reproducing the form of his Fairyhouse second in June, while Patrick Street and Charlie Brow'n are also respected. PURE GRANITE (IRE) PEBBLE ISLAND PATRICK STREET

races.display_title: Sedgefield Racecourse For Outdoor Events Mares' Open NH Flat Race (GBB Race)
races.verdict: CUMNOCK shaped encouragingly from an unpromising position when just failing to make a winning debut over C&D in late August and gets the nod to go one better. Youlooklikeyourmum was only 2 lengths behind the selection in the aforementioned race and should be capable of making her presence felt again, while Moyanna wouldn't need to improve much on her opening effort in the spring to have a big say in proceedings. CUMNOCK YOULOOKLIKEYOURMUM MOYANNA

races.verdict: The return to all-weather with cheekpieces back on should see TIMELY AFFAIR quickly back on his game so he's awarded the vote to improve his already impressive strike rate for one of his ability. Stall 1 may not be ideal if Silver Trumpet blows the start again but he's a huge threat at this level, with Caragio also of interest. TIMELY AFFAIR SILVER TRUMPET CARAGIO (IRE)

races.display_title: Construction Day 14th October Apprentice Handicap
races.verdict: KING CHERRY seemed well suited by the switch to front-running tactics over this sprint trip when winning at Kempton last week and can follow up under a penalty. Asadjumeirah looks the main danger on recent form, though it's been a while since he's tackled turf, with Golden Prosperity taken to round out the 1-2-3. KING CHERRY (IRE) ASADJUMEIRAH GOLDEN PROSPERITY (IRE)
